description: This file contains unit tests for the ConcurrentLruCache class in the Orleans.Caching namespace. It validates the cache's behavior regarding capacity, eviction, touch/promote/demotion of items across generations, disposal of items, and other cache operations. It also introduces specific test cases to verify multi-generation eviction policy, disposal of resources, and cache integrity after various operations.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruTests
classes.description: A test class utilizing xUnit to verify the functionality of the ConcurrentLruCache implementation, including capacity management, multi-generation behavior, eviction, disposal, and concurrent access scenarios.
